items.quote: But when Moses went in before the LORD to speak with him, he took the vail off, until he came out. And he came out, and spake unto the children of Israel that which he was commanded.
items.claim: When Moses went in before the LORD to speak with him, he took the vail off until he came out, then spake unto the children of Israel what he was commanded
items.action: took the vail off, spake unto the children of Israel
